steps.title: We mail the parts

steps.title: They build it
steps.text: That is the present. You get the reaction, which is the part you actually wanted.

faq.heading: Questions, answered without a smile
faq.intro: The joke is the gift. The answers should still be plain.
faq.seoTitle: Gift Kit FAQ | Make Your Own Crap
faq.seoDescription: Answers about Make Your Own Crap kits: who builds them, how the sample lineup works, shipping, alcohol, and checkout.

items.q: So they have to build it?
items.a: Yes. That is the gift. The parts make something real. The recipient does the assembly.

items.q: Is this Make Your Own Damn Candle?
items.a: Same people, same idea, different shelf. Make Your Own Damn Candle was the candle. This is where the format goes next.

items.q: Are these the final kits and prices?
items.a: No. The six kits are a sample lineup. Every name, parts list, and price is marked as a placeholder until the real catalog is set.
Each kit says so, as a difficulty line and a snark level. Snark is how much the gift teases them. Difficulty is how much work is in the box. Neither one is a dare to do something unsafe.

items.q: Do you ship alcohol in the bitters kit?
items.a: No. The sample bitters kit is botanicals, bottles, and instructions. If a recipe needs high-proof alcohol, they buy that locally.

sections.heading: The idea
sections.body: You want to send something nice. You also think they can handle a small project. The kit is both. A real result, and the work required to get there.

sections.heading: The lineup
sections.body: The six kits on this site are samples. Names, contents, and prices are placeholders. They are here so the shop has a shape while the real list is decided.

sections.heading: Where the shop is
sections.body: The business is in Grayson, Louisiana. That is the address on the record. It is not a claim that a factory tour is available.

privacy.heading: What this site stores

privacy.seoTitle: Privacy Policy | Make Your Own Crap
privacy.seoDescription: How Make Your Own Crap handles the address you type, the cart saved in your browser, and the page view sent to our own server.

sections.heading: What you type
sections.body: A ship-to address, an optional note, and an optional email. Those are for sending a kit and answering you. There is no account.

sections.heading: This browser
sections.body: The cart and a notify-me note stay in local storage on this device. They are not uploaded by that form. Clearing the browser clears them.

sections.heading: Payment
sections.body: Card numbers are not entered here. When a kit has a payment link, the button sends you there, with the details you typed added to the link. That page belongs to the payment provider.

sections.heading: Page views
sections.body: Opening a page sends a note to our own server with the path and the referrer. It is not an advertising network. We do not sell a list.

terms.heading: Terms of sale

sections.heading: Samples
sections.body: Every kit, parts list, and price is a placeholder. A sample price is not an offer to sell at that number.

sections.heading: The gift
sections.body: The recipient builds the thing. The kit is parts and instructions. Read the product page for what is actually in that box, and treat it as a sample until the flag comes off.

sections.heading: Payment
sections.body: Nothing is charged on this site. A payment link on a product is where payment would happen, and the price on that link is the price that would be charged. Until a link is set, no order is placed.

refunds.intro: There is no live checkout, so there is nothing to refund today. This is the working policy for when that changes.
refunds.seoDescription: Working refund terms for Make Your Own Crap kits. Checkout is not open, and this policy is not confirmed yet.

sections.heading: Before it ships
sections.body: The working policy is: if you contact us before a kit ships, we cancel and return the payment. That depends on checkout existing, which it does not yet.

sections.heading: Unopened
sections.body: An unopened kit can come back once a return address is published. A return label and a window are not set, so neither is printed here as if they were.

sections.heading: Already building
sections.body: A kit they have started is parts they have used. The working policy is to replace anything we packed wrong, and not to refund a project they simply did not enjoy.

sections.heading: Sample prices
sections.body: A placeholder price is not a price we have agreed to honor. When the real price is set, it will replace the sample on the product page.
